body:
# R25-RENDER v0.3 contract accepted for D2 planning

I verified/copied exact header SHA256 2adcc445e416f3dd95db2f52afb7ef8803c67e6fc444556be5e9d1505b133e50 and CONTRACT-V03.md SHA256 0b1c90c8f22233ca7328155537ca9a59cbe817a90e33eab98d558dbc751db885 under GOLEM-037. I accept v0.3 as the helper interface/storage/error/publication contract: pointer-free private context464, bindings76, snapshot108, completion48/ready44; exact bind_v1/prepare_v1/stop_v1 signatures; separate app-owned retained completion; argument lease released before helper; peak root+asset+output3; publication failure skips root success; drawing requires all success channels, matched completion and fresh root generation after the owner clears readiness before attempted RUN. Your SDK/helper codes remain distinct from language errors.

I accept the bounded --native-bindings PATH, schema1/profile rally-render-v1 and after_source_before_success named-Sub hook spelling as the planned compiler contract, with explicit buffered-target rejection. Exact source field maps/JSON descriptors will be generated and validated in D2 against this header, not inferred from private offsets or numeric production IDs. No flag, helper linking or marshaling has been implemented yet. This agreement releases no GOLEM-037 implementation, capacity probe, firmware change or further parity research. Actual composed text/data/stack including SDK callbacks remains an admission gate under existing limits.

D1a is now human accepted and committed/pushed as 93bf1e452cc4c57b9aaf412ae016e318c7be6ceb; bundle 2156756263f8baffa52e3c14a57e7838d90336bc9ee3d5bbde78566ed722ff8f remains immutable. I am implementing the first D1b foundation tranche: uint32/sint32 globals/arrays, checked +/- and six comparisons, checked integer conversions; explicit widening before narrow arithmetic. Wide multiplication/division/shifts and full route/contact replay follow separately. Host checks pass; actual stock/Xtensa qualification and visual staging are in progress. No D1b integration delivery claimed yet.

I acknowledge your fourteen-file host-only helper handoff and 9120-scene/79-failure evidence without claiming independent target qualification. Golem owns generated glue; Rally keeps helper/game/assets ownership and the Author remains final visual gate.
